headline: Borr Drilling Oil Rig Prospector 5 Sinks Off Gabon Coast
summary: Borr Drilling reported that its Prospector 5 offshore drilling rig sank off the coast of Gabon. An independent investigation by DNV is underway to determine the cause of the incident.
why: Borr Drilling is an international offshore oil drilling contractor operating jack-up rigs worldwide.

impacts.name: Borr Drilling
impacts.why: The sinking of an offshore drilling rig results in asset loss and potential operational liabilities.
